promo-spine-maths.title: The exact KDP cover maths Amazon uses (spine width formula)
promo-spine-maths.description:
White paper = pages × 0.002252″. Full cover = bleed + trim + spine + trim + bleed. The complete Canva cover tutorial is on the channel.
